_comment: The watch's screen vocabulary: the one list of templates, fields, title parts, lines, LAP actions and behaviours a package's watch.yaml may name. src/watch_spec.py resolves package specs against it; garmin/tools/gen_vocab.py turns it into garmin/core/source/gen/Vocab.mc, so the server and the watch read one table. Every id here is implemented in the watch's core (spec/Fields.mc, Titles.mc, Lines.mc, Actions.mc); add the implementation in the same change as the id. The slot-type defaults reproduce the renderers the watch picked by slot_type before packages owned their screens.

capture._comment: What a session run on either watch sends the server, by the analytics' need ids (src/analytics/vocabulary.NEEDS): `session` for every session (the log itself, the heart rate and the recorded minutes), each template's `records` for its steps — what both the Garmin (garmin/core/source/engine/Wire.mc) and the Apple Watch (WorkoutSessionState, WatchUpload) send. A test step also asks for its standard's result at the end (Save results), whatever its template; `asked` are the outcome fields (data/commons/outcome_fields.yaml) a watch asks for at the end of a step whose screen does not record them — a timed kettlebell set's reps, its cadence — sent with ?spec=1 as the step's `logs`. The scorecard's X3 reads a methodology's lead measure against it (tools/evaluate_packages.py).

sets.doc: Counted sets: LAP ends a set, rest follows.

hold.doc: Timed holds: LAP starts the hold and ends it early.

interval.doc: Work/rest phases that run themselves (EMOM, Tabata, repeats).

for_time.doc: Rounds against the clock; the last round moves on.

distance.doc: Distance: live km against the target, or laps of a short carry.

timed.doc: A block held for a time, often in a zone; counts down and ends itself, switching hands at switchAtSec.

round_timer.doc: A named block with no exercise content (a class): LAP counts rounds.

reps.label: REPS
reps.doc: The working reps of this set.

rpe_or_set.label: RPE|SET
rpe_or_set.doc: The target RPE on an unloaded set that has one, else SET.

cumulative.label: TOTAL
cumulative.doc: Reps so far toward the session total.

rounds_of_target.label: ROUNDS
rounds_of_target.doc: Rounds logged of the target rounds.

time_left.label: TIME LEFT
time_left.doc: Countdown of the step's duration, else the time on it.

zone_or_time.label: ZONE|TIME
zone_or_time.doc: The prescribed HR zone, else the time on a counting-down step.

distance.label: KM|LAPS
distance.doc: Km covered, or laps of a short carry.

distance_target.label: OF KM|METRES|TIME
distance_target.doc: The target distance, the carry's metres, else the time.

distance_km.label: KM
distance_km.doc: Km covered, whatever the slot type.

hold.label: HOLD
hold.doc: The hold's seconds: left while it runs, the target before.

interval.label: INTERVAL|ROUND|RPM|REST
interval.doc: The interval's round, the paced RPM, or the rest phase.

interval_left.label: TIME LEFT|HR TO
interval_left.doc: Time left in the phase, or the HR a gated rest waits for.

block_left.label: LEFT|TIME
block_left.doc: Time left in a named block, else the time on it.

rpm.label: RPM
rpm.doc: The target pace: the exercise's targetRpm, else the metronome_rpm behaviour.

title_parts.name: The exercise (or block) name.
title_parts.load: The working weight, per bell on a double.
title_parts.side: Left or Right while the step is side-tracked (the side_tracked behaviour or a unilateral exercise).
title_parts.switch_side: Left or Right on a block with a hand switch (switchAtSec): a timed block's or each interval's work.
title_parts.wave_pct: The round's % of the load_wave behaviour.
title_parts.zone_or_load: The HR zone, else the load.
title_parts.pack: The pack load on a ruck.

lines.next_step: Next: the step after this one.
lines.last_then_next: Last time (the exercise's `last`, e.g. 24kg × 10) until its first set is done, then next_step.
lines.components: The movements of one round, each with this round's reps (a rep scheme's entry for the rounds logged); the step's own movement leads when it has a count. Else next_step.
lines.ladder_total: Reps so far on the ladder, then next_step.
lines.hold_prompt: Start / end-early prompt for a hold.
lines.interval_next: The coming work or rest phase.
lines.phases: The spec's phases strip, then next_step.
lines.standard_target: A test step's standard: the best result and the number for the next level (the exercise's `standard`, the server's words), else next_step. Set by the server on a test's scored slots, never by a package.

actions.complete_set: Ends the set and starts the rest.
actions.log_round: Counts a round or lap; moves on once the step's countable target (cap, rounds, laps, block time) is reached, or at once when it has none.
actions.toggle_hold: Starts the hold, or ends it early.
actions.next_side: Switches to the other side (a side-tracked practice block worked one side at a time).
actions.skip: Moves on to the next step.

side_tracked.doc: Count each set per side, alternating left and right.

cumulative_target.doc: The session total the cumulative field counts toward.

ladder.doc: Rungs climb 1..peak and back down; {peak: int}.

load_wave.doc: % of the load per interval round.

metronome_rpm.doc: Default pace for the rpm field when the exercise names none.

summary_pages.heart_rate: Average and max HR, the HR over the session.
summary_pages.hr_zones: Time and share in each HR zone, on the athlete's own zones.
summary_pages.training_effect: The watch's aerobic training effect and what it means; Garmin's own, so the Apple Watch has none.
summary_pages.training_status: Recovery time left and VO2 max, as the watch reads them after the session; Garmin's own.

cues._comment: The lead-in both watches count before work that starts on a clock: the last seconds of a rest, and START when Countdown Start is on. A tick on each second, then the go; the words are what the Apple Watch says with Voice on (the Garmin has no speech) and what both screens show.
